title: Rav Shmuel bar Papa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites [Yoma 36a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.37a.11) for the passage that mentions him explaining a teaching before Rav Ada. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Shmuel bar Acha explaining it before Rav Papa. Hyman endorses that reading: Rav Shmuel bar Papa is not found in the Talmud, whereas Rav Shmuel bar Acha is always found with Rav Papa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman favors the Dikdukei Soferim reading and says that Shmuel bar Acha always appears with Rav Papa.

The corresponding passage at 37a names Shmuel bar Papa interpreting a teaching before Rav Ada, as [Heilprin’s Shmuel bar Papa entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3395&lang=en) also records. [Heilprin’s Shmuel bar Acha entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3368&lang=en) cites other passages with Rav Papa.
